title: Genesis 8:10-11 — the 2nd dove returns with an olive leaf
summary: Genesis 8:10-11: after seven more days Noah sends the dove out again and it returns in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf, so Noah knows the water has receded. The slide concludes: 2nd dove lands on a branch / branch broken.

text.text: 10 He waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.
11 When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! Then Noah knew that the water had receded from the earth.
2nd DOVE : Lands on Branch / Branch Broken

numbers.note: Noah waited seven more days before sending the dove again
